items.title: CoreWeave edges past quarterly revenue estimates
items.summary: AI cloud company CoreWeave edged past Wall Street estimates for quarterly ‌revenue on Tuesday, driven by strong ‌demand for its computing services that power AI systems.  So-called neoclouds such as CoreWeave ‌and peer Nebius, ⁠which offer hardware and cloud capacity to other technology companies, have seen ⁠demand skyrocket as a result of relentless enterprise spending on AI.  CoreWeave, whose close ties with ​Nvidia have ​made it a key ​supplier of Nvidia's ‌AI chips, has attracted several high-profile customers so far this year.
